title: Open PostFlight
steps: Keep run.bat running. Open http://127.0.0.1:8080/#/overview
expect: Mission Control loads, left menu displays all 12 sections.

title: Health check
steps: In PowerShell: Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/health
expect: status=UP, publishing=DISABLED

title: Session check
steps: In PowerShell: Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/session
expect: authenticated=False, demo-only warning shown.

title: Data backup
steps: Confirm data/postflight-data.backup.json exists from your earlier Copy-Item command.
expect: Backup file exists. Back up data/media separately if you upload images.

title: All 12 left-menu items
steps: Click each left sidebar section one at a time.
expect: Correct page heading changes; no blank pages, no server error.

title: Top search opens
steps: Click Search content, policy, releases at the top.
expect: Search dialog opens. It searches PAGE names, not real content.

title: Top search filters pages
steps: Search for Policy, then click Policy Studio.
expect: Policy Studio opens.

title: Keyboard search
steps: Press Ctrl + K, type Review, press Enter.
expect: Review Center opens.

title: Escape closes popup
steps: Open search then press Escape.
expect: Popup closes and page remains usable.

title: Notifications bell
steps: Click bell at top right.
expect: A short "No new notifications in this demo" message appears.

title: Back and Forward buttons
steps: Move between two pages, use browser Back and Forward.
expect: Previous and next pages load correctly.

title: Refresh page
steps: Navigate to Content Studio and press Ctrl + R.
expect: Page remains functional and saved draft is loaded from backend.

title: Mobile sidebar
steps: Make browser narrower; click the three-line menu.
expect: Sidebar opens and navigation works.

title: Page headings and labels
steps: Try clicking a plain section heading, KPI number or explanatory text.
expect: Ordinary text is NOT interactive; cursor and page should not falsely imply an action.

title: 7D chart
steps: Click 7D in Release assurance.
expect: Bar count changes to seven day sample data.

title: 14D chart
steps: Click 14D.
expect: Bar count changes; this is illustrative data.

title: 30D chart
steps: Click 30D.
expect: Bar count changes; not connected to live metrics.

title: Export report
steps: Click Export report.
expect: postflight-audit-report.json downloads (audit JSON, not a chart report).

title: New validation
steps: Click New validation.
expect: Validation runs for currently selected draft; opens Validation Center.

title: Recent release row
steps: Click a Recent releases table row.
expect: Release Center opens, but demo row may not be an issued certificate.

title: Open validation queue
steps: Click Open validation queue.
expect: Validation Center opens.

title: Filter workspace cards
steps: Type Meridian into Filter workspaces.
expect: Only Meridian Labs card remains; clear input to see three again.

title: Open workspace
steps: Click Open workspace on Meridian Labs.
expect: Workspace name changes in sidebar, but backend remains a single demo tenant.

title: Inspect project row
steps: Click Q4 Investor Awareness in project table.
expect: Content Studio opens.

title: Invite member
steps: Click Invite member.
expect: Design-preview popup: no invitation is sent.

title: New workspace
steps: Click New workspace.
expect: Design-preview popup: no real workspace is created.

title: Workspace breadcrumb consistency
steps: After selecting Meridian, check top breadcrumb and project heading.
expect: Look for stale Northstar wording; record a bug if the visible workspace labels disagree.

title: Modal Cancel button
steps: Open New draft, then click Cancel.
expect: Dialog closes and no draft is created.

title: Modal close X
steps: Open New draft, then click the X at the top right.
expect: Dialog closes and no draft is created.

title: Click outside dialog
steps: Open New draft, then click on the dimmed area outside the dialog.
expect: Dialog closes; no accidental draft is created.

title: Search is page-only
steps: Search for the name of a draft rather than a module title.
expect: Search currently only lists navigation modules, despite placeholder mentioning content.

title: Open new draft dialog
steps: Click New draft.
expect: Create a new draft dialog opens.

title: Blank title rejected
steps: Leave title empty, click Create draft.
expect: Error message asks for draft title; nothing created.

title: Create draft
steps: Title: QA Test — Financial Awareness. Select default campaign, click Create draft.
expect: New draft appears in Saved drafts; server stores it with version 1.

title: Campaign dropdown truth test
steps: In a later test draft, choose a different campaign option before creating.
expect: Current frontend hardcodes Q4 Investor Awareness; log if chosen campaign is ignored.

title: Switch Saved drafts
steps: Choose another draft, then return to your QA draft.
expect: Correct title and caption load.

title: Edit Post title
steps: Change title, click Save draft.
expect: Saved title persists after refresh.

title: Edit caption
steps: Paste: Get guaranteed returns on your investment with our financial products.
expect: Text appears; character/word counter updates.

title: Live caption preview
steps: With LinkedIn tab selected, type into Caption/body.
expect: Text preview changes immediately.

title: Empty alt text
steps: Clear Image alt text.
expect: Field stays empty, enabling missing-alt finding.

title: Save draft button
steps: Click Save draft.
expect: Toast says persisted to local Java backend.

title: Auto-save
steps: Type one word, wait for autosave, refresh.
expect: Edited text survives refresh.

title: LinkedIn tab
steps: Click LinkedIn.
expect: LinkedIn visual preview becomes selected.

title: X tab
steps: Click X.
expect: X preview is selected; next validation uses X rules.

title: Instagram tab
steps: Click Instagram.
expect: Instagram preview becomes selected.

title: Facebook tab
steps: Click Facebook.
expect: Facebook preview becomes selected.

title: Top preflight button
steps: Click Run preflight in the page header.
expect: Same backend validation behavior as the composer Run preflight button.

title: Bottom preflight button
steps: Click Run preflight below the caption fields.
expect: Same backend validation and navigation to Validation Center.

title: Run preflight with guarantee
steps: Select LinkedIn and click Run preflight.
expect: BLOCKED verdict with FIN-MKT-001 and FIN-MKT-014, plus alt-text finding.

title: Click individual finding
steps: Click a finding row in the Preflight insights panel.
expect: Validation Center opens with finding inspector.

title: View all
steps: Click View all next to issues.
expect: Validation Center opens.

title: Blocked verdict
steps: Open Validation Center after risky draft validation.
expect: BLOCKED shown with Critical and High findings.

title: All severity tab
steps: Click All.
expect: All findings display.

title: Critical filter
steps: Click Critical.
expect: Only Critical findings display.

title: High filter
steps: Click High.
expect: Only High findings display.

title: Medium filter
steps: Click Medium.
expect: Only Medium findings display (Low not separately filterable).

title: Select finding
steps: Click FIN-MKT-001 finding row.
expect: Right-hand inspector shows title, cause, match and fix.

title: Return to editor
steps: Click Return to editor.
expect: Content Studio opens with selected draft.

title: Rerun checks
steps: Click Rerun checks.
expect: New server run is stored and verdict recalculated.

title: Export findings
steps: Click Export findings.
expect: Current implementation exports audit JSON, not a dedicated findings report.

title: Fixed content passes
steps: Replace body with: Build stronger financial habits with practical guidance. Investing involves risk and outcomes may vary. Add meaningful alt text; Run preflight.
expect: PASS with zero findings unless you created another matching custom rule.

title: Warning-only review
steps: Use a non-financial caption with image alt text empty. Validate.
expect: WARN for missing alt text; approval is allowed because it is non-blocking.

title: Empty-body check
steps: Create an empty draft, then Run preflight.
expect: BLOCKED; CONTENT-001 should appear (and potentially A11Y-004).

title: X character budget
steps: Choose X, type >280 characters, add alt text, validate.
expect: High finding PLT-X-011; local character count is approximate.

title: Instagram link warning
steps: Choose Instagram; put https://example.com in non-financial caption and add alt text; validate.
expect: WARN with LINK-006.

title: Rule library tab
steps: Click Rule library.
expect: Baseline policy rules displayed; these are partly illustrative.

title: Policy simulator tab
steps: Click Policy simulator.
expect: Simulation options and impact numbers appear.

title: Advisory simulation
steps: Choose Advisory in Proposed enforcement level.
expect: Estimated impact changes, no real policy is published.

title: Balanced simulation
steps: Choose Balanced.
expect: Estimated impact changes.

title: Strict simulation
steps: Choose Strict.
expect: Estimated impact changes.

title: Version history tab
steps: Click Version history.
expect: Illustrative historical versions shown.

title: Add rule opens
steps: Click Add rule.
expect: Form with title, prohibited phrase and severity opens.

title: Severity selector options
steps: In Add rule dialog, open severity selector; choose Critical, High, Medium and Low in turn.
expect: Four severity choices can be selected; rule is only saved when you click Save rule.

title: Blank rule rejected
steps: Leave rule title / phrase blank, click Save rule.
expect: Error message, no new rule.

title: Create custom rule
steps: Title: Disallow magic profits. Phrase: magical profits guaranteed. Severity: High. Click Save rule.
expect: New ORG-... rule appears, policy version changes.

title: Duplicate phrase rejected
steps: Create a second rule with exact same prohibited phrase.
expect: Server rejects as duplicate (409); no duplicate created.

title: Custom rule enforcement
steps: Create draft with magical profits guaranteed; Run preflight.
expect: High finding with ORG-... rule; draft BLOCKED.

title: Publish version button
steps: Click Publish version.
expect: Design-only popup; no real policy activation workflow.

title: Old approval after new policy
steps: Validate and approve a clean draft, add another new rule, then attempt certificate on old draft.
expect: Server rejects until the draft is validated again against current policy.

title: All filter
steps: Click All.
expect: Shows seeded demo assets and uploaded local assets.

title: Review filter
steps: Click Review.
expect: Shows assets not marked Ready.

title: Ready filter
steps: Click Ready.
expect: Shows assets marked Ready.

title: Upload asset opens
steps: Click Upload asset.
expect: Image selection and alt-text dialog opens.

title: No-file rejected
steps: Click Upload image without selecting a file.
expect: Error: Select a PNG or JPEG image.

title: Valid PNG upload
steps: Choose PNG under 700 kB, enter alt text, click Upload image.
expect: Asset appears with dimensions and Ready status.

title: Missing-alt upload
steps: Upload a different small PNG/JPEG without alt text.
expect: Asset saved with Needs review status.

title: Unsupported file rejected
steps: Try PDF or GIF (browser may prevent choosing it).
expect: Only PNG/JPEG supported; no incompatible asset should be saved.

title: Oversized file rejected
steps: Try a PNG/JPEG above 700 kB.
expect: Error, no asset stored.

title: Asset card click
steps: Click an asset card.
expect: Design-preview popup; asset detail viewer not implemented yet.

title: Workflow designer tab
steps: Click Workflow designer.
expect: Five-stage diagram appears.

title: Select Content validation node
steps: Click the Content validation box in the flow diagram.
expect: Step inspector updates to selected stage.

title: Select Risk classification node
steps: Click the Risk classification box in the flow diagram.
expect: Step inspector updates to selected stage.

title: Select Legal review node
steps: Click the Legal review box in the flow diagram.
expect: Step inspector updates to selected stage.

title: Select Brand review node
steps: Click the Brand review box in the flow diagram.
expect: Step inspector updates to selected stage.

title: Select Release approval node
steps: Click the Release approval box in the flow diagram.
expect: Step inspector updates to selected stage.

title: Test workflow
steps: Click Test workflow.
expect: Server returns a simulated trace; a toast reports step count, no publication.

title: Execution history tab
steps: Click Execution history.
expect: Sample run-history table appears; not a real execution engine.

title: View execution history button
steps: Click View execution history in page header.
expect: Switches to Execution history tab.

title: Templates tab
steps: Click Templates.
expect: Three simulated templates appear.

title: Preview template
steps: Click Preview template.
expect: Design-preview popup; no workflow template is installed.

title: Edit workflow step
steps: Click Edit workflow step in inspector.
expect: Design-preview popup; workflow is not editable/saved.

title: Needs review tab
steps: Click Needs review.
expect: Pending/non-approved drafts show.

title: Changes tab
steps: Click Changes.
expect: Changes requested drafts show.

title: Completed tab
steps: Click Completed.
expect: Approved drafts show.

title: All tab
steps: Click All.
expect: All drafts show.

title: Select an inbox row
steps: Click your QA draft in approval inbox.
expect: Selected draft changes; approval actions target it.

title: Request approval
steps: Click Request approval in header.
expect: Design-preview popup; no invitation/notification dispatched.

title: Approve blocked content
steps: Select risky draft with BLOCKED validation; click Approve selected draft.
expect: Server rejects; no approval granted.

title: Request changes
steps: Select a draft; click Request changes.
expect: Server records Changes requested status.

title: Approve safe draft
steps: Select validated clean QA draft, click Approve selected draft.
expect: Server records Approved status; draft moves to Completed tab.

title: Issue before validation
steps: Select a new unvalidated draft; click Issue certificate.
expect: Server rejects because current validation is required.

title: Issue before approval
steps: Select clean validated but unapproved draft; click Issue certificate.
expect: Server rejects because review approval is required.

title: Issue after approval
steps: Select approved clean QA draft; click Issue certificate.
expect: Certificate created; PF-REL-... appears, READY_FOR_HANDOFF only.

title: Selected release versus new issue
steps: Select a sample release row, then click Issue certificate while your QA draft is selected.
expect: Certificate is issued for the currently selected draft, not the highlighted release row; note UX limitation.

title: Select local release
steps: Click the newly issued PF-REL-... table row.
expect: Evidence panel changes to that release.

title: Select sample release
steps: Click PF-REL-2048 sample row.
expect: Shows illustrative sample record, not a signed issued certificate.

title: Copy certificate details
steps: After issuing release, open certificate dialog and click Copy details.
expect: Current UI copies a demo string rather than full verified evidence; record limitation.

title: Export register
steps: Click Export register.
expect: Downloads audit JSON, not a dedicated release register.

title: Verify via API
steps: PowerShell: $r=Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/releases; Invoke-RestMethod "http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/releases/$($r[0].id)/verify"
expect: signatureValid=True, published=False.

title: Edit invalidates approval
steps: Edit already-approved QA draft and click Issue certificate without revalidating/reapproving.
expect: Server rejects a new certificate. Historical certificate remains valid.

title: Select incident row
steps: Click a listed incident.
expect: Right-hand inspector updates to selected incident.

title: Mark resolved
steps: Select open incident and click Mark resolved.
expect: Server stores Resolved; persists after refresh.

title: Escalate
steps: Click Escalate.
expect: Design-preview popup; no external case is filed.

title: Create incident
steps: Click Create incident.
expect: Design-preview popup; no real new incident.

title: Export incident log
steps: Click Export incident log.
expect: Audit JSON downloads, not a dedicated incident export.

title: Zernio Details
steps: Find Zernio card and click Details.
expect: Design-preview popup; no external connection or operation.

title: Local Java API Details
steps: Find Local Java API card and click Details.
expect: Design-preview popup; no external connection or operation.

title: Webhooks Details
steps: Find Webhooks card and click Details.
expect: Design-preview popup; no external connection or operation.

title: Object storage Details
steps: Find Object storage card and click Details.
expect: Design-preview popup; no external connection or operation.

title: API documentation
steps: Click API documentation.
expect: Design-preview popup; the local docs/API.md is the actual documentation.

title: Add integration
steps: Click Add integration.
expect: Design-preview popup; no integration is created.

title: Publishing disabled
steps: Read Zernio and webhook status on cards.
expect: Shows Not connected/Not configured; no Publish action actually posts.

title: Invite member
steps: Click Invite member.
expect: Design-preview popup; no invite sent.

title: Toggle Mandatory legal sign-off
steps: Click the switch for Mandatory legal sign-off; click it again.
expect: Switch appearance changes locally, but does not change backend permissions or policy.

title: Toggle Audit trail enabled
steps: Click the switch for Audit trail enabled; click it again.
expect: Switch appearance changes locally, but does not change backend permissions or policy.

title: Toggle Reviewer notifications
steps: Click the switch for Reviewer notifications; click it again.
expect: Switch appearance changes locally, but does not change backend permissions or policy.

title: Reload after toggle
steps: Toggle a governance setting and refresh.
expect: Preference may reset; these switches are illustrative, not persisted.

title: Reset cancel path
steps: Click Reset demo data, then Cancel in browser confirmation.
expect: No data is deleted.

title: Reset confirm path — LAST
steps: After all tests and after backup, click Reset demo data, then OK.
expect: Seed records restored; test-created drafts/rules/releases reset.

title: Backend persistence
steps: Save draft, stop server with Ctrl+C, restart run.bat, reopen browser.
expect: Draft persists and health is UP.

title: Verify audit chain
steps: PowerShell: (Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/audit).chainValid
expect: True.

title: Unknown API
steps: PowerShell: try { Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/does-not-exist } catch { $_.Exception.Response.StatusCode }
expect: Returns 404, server stays alive.

title: Conflict-safe editing (API)
steps: Run stale expectedVersion test in developer checklist / API guide.
expect: Conflicting old revision is rejected with HTTP 409.

title: Keep local only
steps: Inspect /api/session and browser URL, do not configure public port forward.
expect: App remains loopback-only, no external publishing.

title: Look for unintended changes
steps: After pressing demo-only buttons, check Drafts and Audit.
expect: Demo buttons should not create backend entities or claim external success.

title: Accessibility keyboard navigation
steps: Use Tab / Shift+Tab and Enter on menus/forms.
expect: Visible focus, usable controls; report missing focus or keyboard support.

title: Small-screen layout
steps: Resize browser to phone-width or use browser developer responsive view.
expect: Menu opens; content remains usable without broken overlap.

title: Console errors
steps: Press F12, open Console, repeat basic workflow.
expect: No uncaught exceptions (network errors from deliberate failures are explained).
